units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 129:1">Sifré Num. 129</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 19:18">Num. XIX, 18</cite>) <he>אשר היו שם בשעת ק׳ טומאה</he> ‘which had been there’ at the time of catching the uncleanness.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:1">Zeb. V, 1</cite> <he>ק׳ דמן וכ׳</he> their blood must be received in a consecrated vessel (v. <cite ref="U02049"><he>שָׁרֵת</he></cite>).

Ib. I, 4 (13ᵃ) הזבח נפסל … בק׳ וכ׳ the sacrifice becomes unfit through wrong intentions in one of four acts, in slaughtering, receiving (the blood) &c.; a. fr.—כלי ק׳, בית ק׳ (or sub. כלי) a receptacle, opp. פָּשׁוּט.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:9">Bets. II, 9</cite> <he>משום כלי ק׳</he> is susceptible of uncleanness, because it is a receptacle.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 6:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. VI, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q02054"><he>פָּשׁוּט</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 115:1">Sifré Num. 115</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:8">Yalk. Num. 750</cite> <he>פרשה שיש בה ק׳ מלכות שמים</he> a Biblical section in which is expressed the acceptance of the divine kingdom.
